LanguageData.ColonyCommand_ChipAllTip: Every colonist matching the search. Clears the status and skill filters.
LanguageData.ColonyCommand_ChipDraftedTip: Colonists that are drafted right now. Click again to turn the filter off.
LanguageData.ColonyCommand_ChipInjuredTip: Colonists with a current injury that can heal. Scars do not count. Click again to turn the filter off.
LanguageData.ColonyCommand_ChipIdleTip: Colonists the colonist bar shows the idle icon for. Click again to turn the filter off.
LanguageData.ColonyCommand_ResetTip: Clear the search, filters and sorting and show the colonist bar as the game has it.
